area: Area 1: built-in and contrib text search
current_formulation: GIN and GiST trigram indexes serve similarity, LIKE, ILIKE, regular expressions, and equality.

steps.formulation: A trigram index class serves similarity searches.
steps.quote: The pg_trgm contrib module provides functions and index classes for determining the similarity of text based on trigram matching.

steps.formulation: Trigram indexes serve LIKE and ILIKE, also for patterns that are not left-anchored (commit of 2011-02-01).
steps.quote: Support LIKE and ILIKE index searches via contrib/pg_trgm indexes.

criticism.quote: The worst case, with no trigrams, degrades to a full-table scan

steps.formulation: Trigram indexes serve regular expressions by extracting trigrams from the expression (commit of 2013-04-09).
steps.quote: This works by extracting trigrams from the given regular expression

criticism.quote: Currently, only GIN indexes are supported. We might be able to make it work with GiST indexes later.

steps.formulation: GiST and GIN trigram indexes serve equality lookups (release 14).
steps.quote: Allow GiST/GIN pg_trgm indexes to do equality lookups (Julien Rouhaud)
